description: Pinnacle sportsbook prices (the sharpest market-making book) from its public guest API: upcoming matchups of a league with start time, home/away participants and the main full-game lines — moneyline (incl. draw), handicap/spread and total with American odds, team totals, betting cutoff and max stake. Find a league by name within a sport (soccer, basketball, football, hockey, baseball, tennis, mma) or pass Pinnacle's league ID. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

league.description: League name as Pinnacle shows it, e.g. England - Premier League, NFL, NBA

leagueId.description: Pinnacle league ID, e.g. 1980 (skips the name lookup)

sport.description: soccer, basketball, football, hockey, baseball, tennis, mma

team.description: Only matchups with this participant name
